decisions.reason: Archiving and reporting software close to the core offer, with its own web page, costs little to keep and still holds uncertain upside that fits the firm's move toward data-driven infrastructure management.
This second archiving and reporting product overlaps with A and is only mentioned on the website, so it may be merged, but its low carrying cost means the option is still worth keeping for now.
The manhole floor door with integrated railing is a standardized hardware module with its own page and serves municipal water customers, so it costs little to keep while its demand becomes clear.
The floating sludge extractor builds on the core treatment-plant offer and after only one year shows no evidence of failure, so keeping it preserves a cheap option.
Control technology for water engineering machinery is central to the firm's automation strategy and is cheap to maintain alongside existing work, so the option remains valuable.
